name: SNIPS Voice Platform Natural Language Understanding Benchmark
description: SNIPS Natural Language Understanding Benchmark is a curated intent classification and slot tagging dataset designed for evaluating voice assistants. Comprising 14,484 voice commands across 7 intents (such as AddToPlaylist, BookRestaurant, GetWeather, PlayMusic, RateBook, SearchCreativeWork, SearchScreeningEvent) across 10 slot categories.
